roadmap.title: Base game: general and faction goals
roadmap.description: Play ordinary matches against AI or online; local multiplayer does not count. Awards arrive when the match ends, and an action that also ends the match with a win may not count. Do the one-match faction goals while you rack up crafts and clear the Standard challenges.

roadmap.title: Riverfolk Expansion
roadmap.description: Own the Riverfolk Expansion. Play the Lizard Cult, Riverfolk Company and the Arbiter and Scoundrel Vagabonds for their goals. Corner the Market is easiest on the Mountain map.

roadmap.title: Underworld Expansion
roadmap.description: Own the Underworld Expansion. Play the Corvid Conspiracy and Underground Duchy, and use the Lake and Mountain maps for the ferry and path goals.

roadmap.title: Marauder Expansion
roadmap.description: Own the Marauder Expansion. Play the Lord of the Hundreds and Keepers in Iron for their single-match goals.

roadmap.title: Hirelings & Landmarks
roadmap.description: Own Hirelings & Landmarks. Set up matches with the landmark or hireling you need and, for several, fewer than 4 players.

roadmap.title: Win 25 games per faction
roadmap.description: Do this last or alongside the others. Each faction needs 25 wins of its own, and challenge wins count. It is by far the longest part.

achievements.description: Win a game using Dominance.
achievements.summary: Win a match by activating a Dominance card.

guide.context: As the Vagabond, activating Dominance starts a Coalition instead, which counts for Coalition Victory, not this.

steps.text: Reach 10 victory points so you can activate a @mechanic{Dominance} card. If you hold none, swap another card for a discarded one.
Activate the card, then rule the clearings it names at the start of your next turn. Fill them with warriors and keep Ambush cards ready.

achievements.description: Share a victory in a Coalition.
achievements.summary: Win a match together with another player in a Coalition.

guide.context: A Vagabond in a Coalition can no longer score. If you hold no Dominance card, swap another card for a discarded one.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Vagabond}, or trail everyone on points at the moment a Vagabond activates a Dominance card.

Activate a Dominance card as the Vagabond to team up with the lowest-scoring player. Then help them win: aid players for cards, attack rivals to stop their scoring, and clear clearings for your partner.

achievements.description: Have a dozen cards in your decree at once as the Eyrie Dynasties.
achievements.summary: Have 12 cards in your Decree at once as the Eyrie Dynasties.

steps.text: Add two cards each time you expand the Decree, using bird cards when you can.
Keep the Decree balanced with easy actions, and take plenty of Move actions.

achievements.description: Have all three bases on the map at once as the Woodland Alliance.
achievements.summary: Have the Woodland Alliance's three bases on the map together.

steps.text: Put a sympathy token on a rabbit, a mouse and a fox clearing, and hold all three.
Place a base on each. A base needs a sympathy token on a clearing of its suit and spends matching supporters.
Defend them with guerrilla war until all three bases are out together.

achievements.description: Have at least one of each kind of item at once as the Vagabond.
achievements.summary: Hold all eight item types at once as the Vagabond: torch, boot, bag, sword, hammer, crossbow, coin stack and root tea.

guide.context: Thief starts with root tea and Ranger with a crossbow. Vagrant (coin stack), Scoundrel (crossbow) and Harrier (coin stack and crossbow) need extra DLC, but this can be done without them.

steps.text: Take the boot, bag, hammer and sword from the four ruins. Your torch is a starting item.
Get a coin stack, a crossbow and root tea by crafting, by aiding another player, or from starting gear.

achievements.description: Have 25 Warriors on the map as the Marquise de Cat.
achievements.summary: Have all 25 warriors on the map at once as the Marquise de Cat.

steps.text: Recruit until none of your warriors are in your supply.
Make sure the Riverfolk Company holds none of your warriors in its funds.

achievements.description: Win 25 games as the Woodland Alliance.
achievements.summary: Reach 25 match wins playing @mechanic{Woodland Alliance}.

guide.context: Challenge wins count too, so finish challenges for this faction and take easy ones to speed up.

steps.text: Keep winning matches with @mechanic{Woodland Alliance} until you have 25 wins in total.

achievements.description: Win 25 games as the Marquise de Cat.
achievements.summary: Reach 25 match wins playing @mechanic{Marquise de Cat}.

guide.context: Challenge wins count too, so finish challenges for this faction and take easy ones to speed up.

steps.text: Keep winning matches with @mechanic{Marquise de Cat} until you have 25 wins in total.

achievements.description: Win 25 games as the Vagabond.
achievements.summary: Reach 25 match wins playing @mechanic{Vagabond}.

guide.context: Challenge wins count too, so finish challenges for this faction and take easy ones to speed up.

steps.text: Keep winning matches with @mechanic{Vagabond} until you have 25 wins in total.

achievements.description: Win 25 games as the Eyrie Dynasties.
achievements.summary: Reach 25 match wins playing @mechanic{Eyrie Dynasties}.

guide.context: Challenge wins count too, so finish challenges for this faction and take easy ones to speed up.

steps.text: Keep winning matches with @mechanic{Eyrie Dynasties} until you have 25 wins in total.

achievements.description: Eliminate all attacking warriors with an Ambush.
achievements.summary: Remove every attacking warrior with an Ambush card.

guide.context: The attacker cannot answer with an Ambush of their own, or the attempt fails.

steps.text: Keep an Ambush card in your hand.
When another player attacks with one or two warriors in a clearing matching the card, play it. The Ambush removes up to two attackers, so it must clear them all.

achievements.description: Improve your relationship with 3 different factions in one game as the Vagabond.
achievements.summary: As the Vagabond, raise your standing with three different factions in one match.

guide.context: Never attack a player you want to improve with, because attacking ends improvement with that faction. Retry next match if you did.

steps.text: Give each of three other players a card. Reaching the first relationship level with each is enough.

achievements.description: Command allied warriors to move or battle as the Vagabond.
achievements.summary: Move or battle with another faction's warriors as the Vagabond.

guide.context: Attacking that faction stops further improvement.

steps.text: Improve your relationship with one faction three times.
In a clearing with that faction's warriors, use the command ability to move or battle with them.

achievements.description: Craft 50 times.
achievements.summary: Craft 50 times.

guide.context: Crafts add up across matches. Woodland Alliance, Riverfolk Company and Underground Duchy craft the most.

steps.text: Craft cards in matches until your total reaches 50.

achievements.description: Destroy 5 or more enemy pieces in a single revolt as the Woodland Alliance.
achievements.summary: As the Woodland Alliance, wipe out 5 or more enemy pieces with one revolt.

steps.text: Find a clearing holding 5 or more enemy warriors, buildings and tokens in any mix.
Start a revolt there.

achievements.description: Complete an entire game without entering Turmoil as the Eyrie Dynasty.
achievements.summary: Finish a whole match without entering Turmoil as the Eyrie Dynasties.

guide.context: Turmoil ends the attempt. Start a new match to try again.

steps.text: Add one card to the Decree at a time, mostly bird cards, with easy actions.
Add at most one Build action because roosts are limited. Play safe even if it costs you the win.

achievements.description: Overwork two turns in a row as Marquise de Cat.
achievements.summary: Overwork on two turns in a row as the Marquise de Cat.

guide.context: Overwork cannot be used while 8 wood tokens are on the map.

steps.text: Keep two cards that match clearings with sawmills.
Use Overwork on two turns in a row, each time discarding a matching card to make a wood token.

achievements.description: Destroy 2 enemy buildings in a single battle.
achievements.summary: Wipe out two enemy buildings within one battle.

steps.text: Attack a clearing with two enemy buildings, stacking warriors and playing combat cards to hit hard.

achievements.description: Complete all challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete every challenge in the Standard tab, including the harder versions.

guide.context: Challenges from updates and expansions do not count.

steps.text: Beat each challenge in the Standard tab.
Then beat the harder version each one unlocks.

achievements.description: Win 25 games as the Lizard Cult.
achievements.summary: Reach 25 match wins playing @mechanic{Lizard Cult}.

guide.context: Challenge wins count too, so finish challenges for this faction and take easy ones to speed up.

steps.text: Keep winning matches with @mechanic{Lizard Cult} until you have 25 wins in total.

achievements.description: Win 25 games as the Riverfolk Company.
achievements.summary: Reach 25 match wins playing @mechanic{Riverfolk Company}.

guide.context: Challenge wins count too, so finish challenges for this faction and take easy ones to speed up.

steps.text: Keep winning matches with @mechanic{Riverfolk Company} until you have 25 wins in total.

achievements.description: Establish a Trade Post in every river clearing.
achievements.summary: As the Riverfolk Company, put a Trade Post in each clearing that touches a river.

guide.context: The Mountain and Lake maps need the Underworld Expansion.

steps.text: Pick a map: the Mountain map has only 3 river clearings, Lake and Winter 4, Autumn 5.
Place a Trade Post in each clearing that touches water.

achievements.description: Crusade 15 times.
achievements.summary: Crusade 15 times as the Lizard Cult.

guide.context: Crusades add up across matches.

steps.text: Spend 2 acolytes on Crusade (move, then battle) until your total reaches 15.

achievements.description: Sell 100 services.
achievements.summary: Sell 100 services as the Riverfolk Company.

guide.context: Sales add up across matches.

steps.text: Set your service price to the lowest and sell until your total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Perform 3+ Conspiracies in a single round.
achievements.summary: Perform 3 or more conspiracies in a single round as the Lizard Cult.

steps.text: Save 6 acolytes.
Do three conspiracies in one turn. Sanctify costs 3 acolytes, and Crusade and Convert cost 2 each.

achievements.description: Remove 10+ pieces in a single action with the Scoundrel's Scorched Earth ability.
achievements.summary: Remove 10 or more pieces with one Scorched Earth as the Scoundrel Vagabond.

steps.text: Find a clearing with 10 or more tokens, buildings and warriors in any mix.
Use Scorched Earth there.

achievements.description: Assist 10 players in battle as the Arbiter.
achievements.summary: As the Arbiter, help 10 other players in their battles.

guide.context: Other players must choose to use it. Chatting with them in multiplayer helps.

steps.text: Stand in clearings where fights are likely.
Let other players use your ability to help in battle. Do this 10 times in total.

achievements.description: Win 25 games as the Underground Duchy.
achievements.summary: Reach 25 match wins playing @mechanic{Underground Duchy}.

guide.context: Challenge wins count too, so finish challenges for this faction and take easy ones to speed up.

steps.text: Keep winning matches with @mechanic{Underground Duchy} until you have 25 wins in total.

achievements.description: Have all three lord ministers in play at once.
achievements.summary: As the Underground Duchy, have the three lord ministers out at the same time.

guide.context: Each destroyed building costs you one of your highest ministers. Avoid matches with the Lizard Cult or the Scoundrel Vagabond, who can destroy buildings directly.

steps.text: Keep your buildings together in a few guarded clearings.
Sway the lords using your hand and tiles that match the suits of your cards.
Stop all building losses for at least two turns.

achievements.description: Move 5 or more warriors from the Burrow to the map in a single move.
achievements.summary: As the Underground Duchy, bring 5 or more warriors out of the Burrow onto the map with one move.

steps.text: Get at least 5 warriors into the Burrow by recruiting or moving them there.
Bring them all out with one move action.

achievements.description: Win 25 games as the Corvid Conspiracy.
achievements.summary: Reach 25 match wins playing @mechanic{Corvid Conspiracy}.

guide.context: Challenge wins count too, so finish challenges for this faction and take easy ones to speed up.

steps.text: Keep winning matches with @mechanic{Corvid Conspiracy} until you have 25 wins in total.

achievements.description: Remove 5 or more enemy pieces with a single Bomb Plot.
achievements.summary: As the Corvid Conspiracy, kill 5 or more enemy pieces with one flipped Bomb Plot.

steps.text: Place a bomb plot in a clearing holding 5 or more enemy tokens, buildings and warriors in any mix.
Flip it.

achievements.description: End a turn with one of each Plot type on the map.
achievements.summary: As the Corvid Conspiracy, finish a turn with a bomb, extortion, snare and raid plot all on the map.

steps.text: Place a bomb, extortion, snare and raid plot, in any turns and in any flip state.
End a turn with all four on the map.

achievements.description: Start a battle in a clearing you just moved to with the Ferry on the Lake Map.
achievements.summary: On the Lake map, begin a battle in the clearing you have just reached using the Ferry.

steps.text: Move out of the Ferry's clearing to a clearing beside the lake that holds enemy warriors.
Use a spare action to battle there right away.

achievements.description: Use the Ferry 20 times on the Lake Map.
achievements.summary: Use the Ferry 20 times on the Lake map.

guide.context: Uses add up across matches.

steps.text: Once a turn, move pieces from the Ferry's clearing to another clearing beside the lake, until your total reaches 20.

achievements.description: Score the Tower for 3 turns in a row on the Mountain Map.
achievements.summary: On the Mountain map, score the Tower on three of your turns in a row.

guide.context: Lizard Cult (gardens give automatic rule) and Marquise de Cat (many warriors) are good fits.

steps.text: Rule the Tower clearing when your turn ends to earn its victory point.
Do it on 3 turns in a row. Retake the clearing on your turn if a rival takes it.

achievements.description: Clear 20 closed paths on the Mountain Map.
achievements.summary: Clear 20 closed paths on the Mountain map.

guide.context: Paths add up across matches.

steps.text: Pay a card to open a blocked path, once per turn, until your total reaches 20.

achievements.description: Win 25 games as the Keepers in Iron.
achievements.summary: Reach 25 match wins playing @mechanic{Keepers in Iron}.

guide.context: Challenge wins count too, so finish challenges for this faction and take easy ones to speed up.

steps.text: Keep winning matches with @mechanic{Keepers in Iron} until you have 25 wins in total.

achievements.description: Score 3 columns of Relics in a single game as Keepers in Iron.
achievements.summary: As the Keepers in Iron, score three columns of Relics in one match.

guide.context: Relics give many points, at least 19 for nine, so the risk is winning before you finish.

steps.text: Collect 3 relics of each type, nine in all, taking the 1- and 2-point ones and never a fourth in a column.
Do not destroy buildings or tokens, and do not craft cards that give points.
Use Retinue movement to reach spread-out relics.

achievements.description: Complete a game without losing any warriors to Live off the Land as Keepers in Iron.
achievements.summary: As the Keepers in Iron, play a whole match without Live off the Land costing you a warrior.

guide.context: A Vagabond allied with you can move your warriors, so watch for that. Start a new match if you lose one.

steps.text: End every turn with no more than 3 of your warriors in any clearing.
Use Retinue movement to empty crowded clearings.

achievements.description: Win 25 games as the Lord of the Hundreds.
achievements.summary: Reach 25 match wins playing @mechanic{Lord of the Hundreds}.

guide.context: Challenge wins count too, so finish challenges for this faction and take easy ones to speed up.

steps.text: Keep winning matches with @mechanic{Lord of the Hundreds} until you have 25 wins in total.

achievements.description: Oppress 7 clearings in one turn as the Lord of the Hundreds.
achievements.summary: As the Lord of the Hundreds, oppress seven clearings during one turn.

steps.text: Build up warriors and fill your hoard for many actions.
Fight until you have warriors alone in 7 clearings with nothing else there.

achievements.description: Experience every mood in a single game as Lord of the Hundreds.
achievements.summary: Experience every mood in a single match as the Lord of the Hundreds.

steps.text: Write down the moods you have used.
Add only items that match moods you have not used yet, since each item type disables one mood.

achievements.description: Remove 10 or more enemy pieces in a single turn as Lord of the Hundreds.
achievements.summary: As the Lord of the Hundreds, remove 10 or more enemy pieces during one turn.

steps.text: Fill the hoard for many actions.
Kill warriors, and use mobs to remove buildings and tokens. Favour cards count too.

achievements.description: Have a full Retinue (10 cards) as Keepers in Iron.
achievements.summary: Have a full Retinue of 10 cards as the Keepers in Iron.

guide.context: You lose a card when you delve or recover a relic without ruling as many clearings as its value.

steps.text: Place all 3 waystations for more card draw and keep your cards.
Recover a relic of unknown value only if you rule 3 clearings around it.

achievements.description: Deal 3 hits with The Exile hireling in a single combat.
achievements.summary: Land 3 hits in a single fight using the Exile hireling.

guide.context: Cards, hirelings or abilities that block hits ruin the roll. More items give more moves and retries.

steps.text: Give the Exile crafted items. Get at least 3.
Fight a clearing with at least 3 pieces and roll 3 hits.

achievements.description: Remove 5 or more enemy pieces with the Spring Uprising hireling in a single turn.
achievements.summary: With the Spring Uprising hireling, remove 5 or more enemy pieces during one turn.

guide.context: The warrior's removal also clears every enemy piece from that clearing. Keepers in Iron, Underground Duchy or Marquise de Cat make crowded clearings likely.

steps.text: Place its warriors in busy clearings.
Roll the die for a suit and remove a warrior from a matching clearing holding 5 or more enemy pieces.

achievements.description: Battle twice in one turn with the Last Dynasty hireling.
achievements.summary: Fight two battles in the same turn using the Last Dynasty hireling.

guide.context: It battles twice only from a clearing it does not rule.

steps.text: Take control of the Last Dynasty.
Battle a weak target first so its warriors survive, then battle again.

achievements.description: Move 6 or more Forest Patrol hireling warriors from one clearing to another.
achievements.summary: Move at least 6 Forest Patrol hireling warriors together from one clearing into another.

steps.text: Use the place action to put all removed warriors in one clearing, late in the match.
Keep the group away from enemies, then move all 6 or more together next turn.

achievements.description: Force multiple enemy players to move in a single turn with the Popular Band hireling.
achievements.summary: Make several enemy players move during one turn with the Popular Band hireling.

steps.text: Put a Popular Band warrior in a central clearing.
Use it to pull one warrior from each neighbouring clearing, so that at least two neighbours belong to different players.

achievements.description: Remove a Marquise Keep or Alliance Base with hirelings.
achievements.summary: Use hirelings to destroy a Marquise Keep or an Alliance Base.

steps.text: Play with fewer players so more hirelings are promoted, such as the Exile or Forest Patrol.
Use them to destroy a Keep or Base.

achievements.description: End a turn with control of two hirelings and ruling two landmarks clearings.
achievements.summary: End a turn controlling two hirelings and ruling two landmark clearings.

guide.context: Hirelings are often passed to the player in last place.

steps.text: In setup, raise the landmark count from 1 to 2 and place them close together.
End a turn controlling two hirelings and ruling both landmark clearings.

achievements.description: End your turn ruling a landmark clearing without any of your faction pieces there.
achievements.summary: Finish your turn ruling a landmark clearing where your own faction has no pieces.

guide.context: Riverfolk Company warriors also count toward your rule once you buy Mercenaries.

steps.text: Use promoted hirelings with many warriors, such as Forest Patrol or Sunward Expedition, and a remote landmark.
Place their warriors on it, remove your own, and be the strongest there.

achievements.description: Remove an enemy building in the Elder Treetop building slot.
achievements.summary: Destroy an enemy building sitting in the Elder Treetop's extra slot.

steps.text: Play against factions that build a lot, such as Marquise de Cat or Underground Duchy.
Attack the clearing and destroy the building in the extra slot.

achievements.description: Remove 2 or more hireling warriors in a single combat with another hireling.
achievements.summary: Kill 2 or more hireling warriors during one fight started by another hireling.

guide.context: Abilities that remove pieces directly do not count.

steps.text: Keep the match to fewer than 4 players so several hirelings get promoted, such as Last Dynasty or the Exile.
Start a fight with your hireling in a clearing where another hireling has at least two warriors, and deal 2 or more hits.

achievements.description: Rule the clearing with the Lost City for 3 or more consecutive turns.
achievements.summary: Rule the Lost City's clearing at the end of three or more turns in a row.

guide.context: Lizard Cult and Lord of the Hundreds can take the clearing from you even when you hold many warriors there.

steps.text: Start near the Lost City and take it early.
Fill it with warriors and rule it on 3 turns in a row.

achievements.description: Craft 4 items from the Legendary Forge in a single game.
achievements.summary: Craft four Legendary Forge items during one match.

guide.context: Each crafted Forge item gives 1 victory point and a card.

steps.text: Choose a faction with strong card draw and crafting.
Hold the Forge's clearing clear of enemies so only you can craft.
Craft all four Forge items.

achievements.description: Swap 5 cards with the Black Market in a single game.
achievements.summary: Trade cards with the Black Market on five turns in one match.

steps.text: Keep a piece in the Black Market's clearing.
Once per turn, trade one of your cards for one of the 3 cards on offer. Do this on 5 turns.
